_comment: Baseline snapshot of per-tutor PRE-K-12 coverageMatrix counts. Remediation Sprint 01 reset this to the HONEST floor: a band counts as authored only when >=3 real production item-bank items back it AND a signed, non-draft skill graph covers it (machine-checked by scripts/curriculum-coverage-check.mjs — promotion guard + item-count bar). The previous all-authored snapshot was owner-attestation only and is superseded. Drift rule unchanged: any tutor's authored count decreasing or missing count increasing is a hard fail; increases require updating this file in the same PR.
